_comment: Connection settings for the dev-DB tooling. Copy to dev-db.config.json and edit.
dev-db.config.json is gitignored because it contains paths specific to your machine.
No passwords live here. They are resolved at call time into MYSQL_PWD for the lifetime
of one child process: never written to disk, never printed, never placed on a command
line where the process table and mysql's own insecurity warning would expose them.
source = the live schema you read the real structure FROM. Read-only by contract.
dev    = the disposable schema this project writes TO. The only writable target.

_sourcePasswordFileComment: Optional convenience: if passwordEnv is unset, parse the password out of a
TrinityCore .conf file whose value is host;port;user;pass;db. Point this at your own
worldserver.conf, or delete both keys and rely on the env var alone.

_tablesComment: The spawn-editing working set. Structure is copied from source, never data.
